# eventfulranges

> A CRDT over real-valued ranges and n-dimensional boxes in Go: replicas add and remove ranges locally, exchange operations, and converge in any arrival order.

Module `github.com/d-led/eventfulranges` · Go 1.27, pinned in `go.work` · license MPL-2.0.

## Reference (exact behavior)

- [CRDT map](docs/CRDT.md): the four strategies for 1-D and n-D, which package holds each, the bounds asymmetry, the facades.
- [Extensions](docs/EXTENSIONS.md): what ships and what is proposed, the canonicalizer seam, metadata merge, region queries.

## Tutorials (getting started)

- [Quick start](README.md#quick-start): open a replica, add and remove ranges, converge two replicas.
- [Calendar example](examples/calendar): a standalone module that books and cancels vacations.

## How-to guides (specific tasks)

- [Demos](README.md#demos): run hello, local, pubsub, network, web, paint, KurrentDB, Automerge.
- [Browser-only WebAssembly build](docs/WASM.md#deploying-to-github-pages): build and deploy the static visualizer.

## Explanation (architecture and concepts)

- [Design](docs/DESIGN.md): the operation-based model, engine, stores, clocks, testing.
- [n-D ranges](docs/N-DIM.md): boxes, covers, paint layers.
- [WebAssembly build](docs/WASM.md): how the session hub runs in a page with no server.

## For repository work

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): build commands, layout, invariants.
